identity.title: Source-Grounded Alpha Research and Genuine Polymarket Agents Discovery
identity.objective: Add one actual finite offline native CLI caller over a native observed-universe cohort; rank markets using a Polymarket Agents-inspired local retrieval method, quality-gate caller-supplied historical bytes through existing PIT provenance, cold-verify research receipts and compare >=30 fixed sanitized-synthetic cases against the constructed baseline_plain_v0. Report real-corpus value separately; no product networking or trading.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert only eight tracked changes. All original PIT/Alpha/Hermes/canonical records and separately owned PR268 and Lane B remain untouched; scratch output is external and non-canonical.

api_matrix.reason: One finite offline advisory-only adapter in existing source-runtime and one scratch CLI; all upstream core interfaces remain read-only.
